title: Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation With Cross-Consistency Training (CCT)
mechanism: Enforce agreement between the main decoder and auxiliary decoders fed perturbed encoder features on unlabelled images.
adaptation: U-Net++ with 3-6 auxiliary decoders, 11.9k pool cells as unlabelled; included mainly because it was the best mIoU on this data family in Torpey 2024.
min_experiment: Arm CCT U-Net++ vs PF, 5 seeds; metric CV mIoU_rob and inactive IoU; kill if mIoU_rob gain < +0.01.
evidence: R (via Torpey 2024): CCT mIoU 0.550 vs 0.506 previous SOTA on CSIR EL, single run.
prior_overlap: Pseudo-label SSL (Mean Teacher, CPS) n.d. at 100%; feature-perturbation consistency is a different mechanism but same SSL family, so expected gain is small.

alt_notes.adaptation: U-Net++ with 3-6 auxiliary decoders, 11.9k pool unlabelled, 100% labels; feature perturbations, not pseudo-labels.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm CCT U-Net++ vs baseline house, 5 seeds; metric CV mIoU_rob; kill if gain < +0.01. About 30 GPU-h.
